walkthroughs.title: Get started with NS Script Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample script, see its summary, entry points and module usage, and try the Pro governance review and version compatibility check in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
NS Script Atlas reads SuiteScript 2.x files: the define() modules with a JSDoc header that sets the API version and script type. The sample is an invented user event script with typical governance and compatibility problems, so every report has something to show. Open it to follow along, or open a script of your own.
[Open Sample File](command:nsScriptAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Script Summary
steps.description:
The script at a glance: API version, script type, module scope, number of modules, exported entry points and header problems. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Script Summary](command:nsScriptAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Entry Point Check, Show Module Usage.
[Show Entry Point Check](command:nsScriptAtlas.showEntryPoints)
[Show Module Usage](command:nsScriptAtlas.showModules)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show Governance Risks, Show Version Compatibility.
[Show Governance Risks](command:nsScriptAtlas.showGovernance)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:nsScriptAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:nsScriptAtlas.reportProblem)

nsScriptAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

nsScriptAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
